body:
This environment insisted on a branch: cursor/u11-promotion-belts-f722 (PR #12). It cannot push master.

U11 is done. PromotionsBoard.read_all() calls get_championships_read() once, unscoped, and hands each org its belts. Unsanctioned (empty organization.id) stay off every row. org_row() prints N BELTS / SANCTIONS NO BELT (never a dash) plus the flagship champion. sort_by_standing_in_sport() calls WorldPopulation.promotions_by_standing(). Did not edit GameState/ChampionshipRead/WorldPopulation/HANDOFF. Digest research/U11_DIGEST.md — please write the HANDOFF block from it and merge the branch.

Parse gate clean. promotions_board_test 111/0. office_hub_panel_test 119/0. schedule_hub_panel_test 72/0. Full suite 178/0.
